course.title: Transport Phenomena in Materials
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Through a refinery, fuel ethanol is flowing in a pipe at a velocity of 2 m/s and a pressure of (10) 102,500 Pa. The refinery needs the ethanol to be at a pressure of 203,800 Pa on a lower level. How far must the pipe drop in height in order to achieve this pressure? Assume that the velocity does not change. (The density of ethanol is 790 kg/m³).

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
